# Refill

> Refill is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that watches your AI usage limits (Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI) and signals the moment a limit resets: notch pop-up, notification, sound, phone push, chat, room lights, webhook or shell hook. Everything stays on your Mac. No account, no telemetry, no Refill server.

Requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer. MIT License. Made by Stepan Blaha. Independent app, not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, Cursor or Google.

## Features

- Sources: multi-account Claude Code (5-hour, weekly, Opus and Sonnet windows), Codex (local session logs), GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI.
- Signals: notch pop-up, native notification, sound, warnings at 80% and 95%, dry-tank alert at 100%. Quiet hours can mute the sound.
- Integrations: ntfy, Pushover, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Home Assistant, Philips Hue, WLED, webhooks, shell hook, Shortcuts, widgets, local dashboard (opt-in).
- Burn-rate chart per source: pace against the clock, projected time until dry.
- Private: usage, history and settings live in ~/.config/refill. Reads undocumented provider endpoints with your own login, which may change.

## Download and install

- Download (latest release): https://github.com/StepanBlaha/Refill/releases/latest/download/Refill.dmg
- Distributed only via GitHub Releases. Not notarized: on first launch, right-click the app and choose Open.
